Re: 

Briefing Schedule in No.  18-1048, GE Energy Power Conversion France SAS,  Corp., 
fka Converteam SAS v.  Outokumpu Stainless USA,  LLC,  et al. 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

I represent Petitioner in GE Energy Power Conversion France SAS,  Corp., fka 
Converteam SAS v. Outokumpu Stainless USA,  LLC,  et al., granted on June 28, 2019.  I am 
writing to respectfully request that the Court adopt a briefing schedule that makes Petitioner's 
opening brief due September 17, Respondents' brief due November 22, and Petitioner's reply 
due December 23.  Counsel for Respondents have agreed to this proposed schedule, which will 
allow the case to be fully briefed before the Court's January sitting. 

Without any change to the briefing schedule, Petitioner's brief would be due August 12, 

Respondents' would be due September 11, and Petitioner's reply would be due October 11. 

Sincerely, 

Shay Dvoretzky
